# requires: wire
#
# Content-Range names bytes 40-63 and the body holds bytes 0-23. Every header
# agrees with every other header and the length is exactly right, so this is the
# case where only the digest is left standing -- which is the argument for
# hashing every transfer rather than trusting a source that answered politely.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=http:lying
claim A alpha 5000
stage A 40
progress A alpha 40 {"verified_prefix":40}
release A alpha
run A beta
orphans
state A

# expect 6: transfer-failed state=pending [DL-R15]
# expect 6: done=0 err=set
# expect 7: ok A
